parameters.generator: fixed equal lengths; guaranteed base vocabulary; seeded randrange and sample placement
parameters.frequent: Fehler at position 0 and every hundredth token in each document
parameters.rare: Verbindung at final token of first document only
parameters.schedule: all six (algorithm,query) complete blocks shuffled once per warmup/repetition with fixed seed

background_load: ordinary desktop background load; operator schedules experiment without parallel project tests or PDF build; not isolated
cache: prepared corpus and built index prechecked and reused; no cold-cache measurement
timer: time.perf_counter_ns; integer elapsed_ns per complete block

timing_boundaries.build: complete public build_inverted_index on already prepared corpus; result check after timer
timing_boundaries.query: public search_direct_word or search_index_word; normalization and full fresh sorted result list included
timing_boundaries.blocks: identical list-of-results and loop overhead in both methods; query_block_size full calls retained then checked
timing_boundaries.excluded: load/preparation, expectation checks, counters, disk output, plotting and memory instrumentation

statistics: median, inclusive Q1/Q3, IQR=Q3-Q1; one block is one sample, quartiles are not confidence intervals

memory.retained_traced_bytes: tracemalloc current_after_build-current_before_build; tracer starts after preparation
memory.exclusive_index_bytes: sys.getsizeof unique index/proxy/backing dict/tuple/str objects, excluding corpus token and ID string identities
memory.limitations: Python traced allocations and object graph estimates, not RSS; corpus and query result memory excluded; no traced times used
